meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把 Resend 邮件适配器复制并注册进项目，装好依赖后构建验证；之后助手能收发邮件，但 Resend 账号、域名与 webhook 仍需你手动设置。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw/Chat SDK 项目接入 Resend 邮件通道时触发，通常发生在 /setup 配置流程中；凭据设置与自我接线步骤也一并带上。

say.text: 给这个项目接入 Resend 邮件通道
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并装好依赖，再构建验证。

say.text: 我的邮箱是 me@example.com，指定 agent 回复我的邮件
跑一下 Resend 通道的注册测试，看是否通过

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Resend email adapter into src/channels, registers it, pins @resend/chat-sdk-adapter@0.1.1, then builds and runs the registration test. Resend account, domain and webhook setup remain manual.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Resend (email) channel to a NanoClaw/Chat SDK project, typically during /setup. It also carries the credential prompts and the self-wiring step.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to this project
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it and installs the pinned dep.

say_en.text: My email is me@example.com - wire me as owner and send a hello
say_en.note: Runs ncl users/roles/wirings and sends the hello email.

say_en.text: Run the Resend registration test and tell me if it passes
